entities.name: Nitro-to-amine reduction
observations: The substrate side-chain nitro group, C(C)[N+](=O)[O−], is converted to a primary amine, C(C)N; methoxy and both aryl chlorides remain unchanged.

entities.name: Zn/HCl reduction
observations: A close exact-core ORD record uses zinc and hydrochloric acid for reduction of the nitro group to the corresponding amine.

entities.name: THF reaction medium
observations: A second close ORD record lists tetrahydrofuran as an additional reactant or solvent but does not identify a conventional reducing reagent; it is less informative for reagent selection.
